articles.title: Kraken in talks to buy 15% stake in DeFi lender Aave at $385 million valuation
articles.snippet: The DeFi lender is rebuilding after the fallout from April's KelpDAO exploit sparked a multibillion-dollar exodus of deposits despite Aave itself not being hacked.

articles.title: BlackBerry is making a massive comeback as an 'uncrashable' software layer for AI and robotics
articles.snippet: BlackBerry's stock is surging after the company's massive earnings beat and is pivoting into becoming a critical component of the AI and robotics boom.

articles.title: Kraken sues crypto derivatives firm PowerTrade over 'misappropriated' funds claim
articles.snippet: PowerTrade changed Kraken’s positive balance of more than $6 million to a $2 million deficit via a series of unauthorized “corrections” related to trades that had expired or settled months earlier, according to a legal filing.

articles.title: Post-prison CZ says time behind bars didn't hurt the billionaire's business after Binance
articles.snippet: The pardoned ex-CEO called prison a character-building "plus" as he's pursued a venture-capital career, despite his majority stake in the world's biggest crypto exchange.

articles.title: Forget max pain theory. Bitcoin is well below the $72,000 magnet going into $10 billion options expiry
articles.snippet: The popular max pain theory isn’t working out as bitcoin trades far from the $72K level a day ahead of a $10 billion quarterly options settlement.
